import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
# Load Transactions sheet
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
# Filter for Program = 'Maternal & Child Health' and Region = 'Bihar'
mask = (df['Program'] == 'Maternal & Child Health') & (df['Region'] == 'Bihar')
filtered = df[mask]
total_spend = filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print('Rows found:', len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Txn ID','Date','Region','Program','Amount (INR)']].head())
print('Total spend:', total_spend)
